protocol.purpose: Adopt already selected P B (.24,.16) against original RAS04 and MMD19; descriptive manuscript update only
protocol.integration: State and slow metrics: trapezoid over both endpoints; Ec/EB/Es square, integrate, root per run; then mean three runs. Lrho/region linear time mean.
protocol.execution: Half-open start-time mask [start,end), h=.02; all 46 aircraft equal weight. A from vector diff(v)/h; Dmap=map-hold; Dsafe=accepted-map.
protocol.aggregation_exceptions: Distance is minimum over all seeds/intervals; center/formation peak is maximum over all seeds/times, never mean of seed peaks. Completion/terminal are integer totals.
protocol.snapshots: First registered seed33001; FW spatial standard deviations recorded with ddof=0 and1; manuscript sample SD uses ddof=1.
protocol.source_metric_scope: Ec/EB rebuilt from history positions and analytic reference stored in fast metrics. Slow density/shape and fast region are existing audited metrics; no new estimator or indicator.
